tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.title: Get my profile
tools.description: Return the signed-in user's Nose Push profile: display name, XP, level, current & longest streak, best pushup count, personal bests per exercise, and battle wins/losses.

tools.name: list_my_workouts
tools.title: List my workouts
tools.description: List the signed-in user's most recent workouts (exercise id, rep count, duration in ms, created_at). Newest first.

limit.description: Maximum workouts to return (1-100). Defaults to 20.

tools.name: log_workout
tools.title: Log a workout
tools.description: Log a completed workout for the signed-in user. Triggers XP, streak, personal-best, and challenge progress updates server-side. Exercise ids include 'pushup', 'squat', 'plank', 'burpee'.

count.description: Rep count (0-1000). For 'plank', pass 0 and use duration_ms.

duration_ms.description: Session duration in milliseconds. Required for 'plank'; use 0 otherwise.

tools.name: get_my_recent_stats
tools.title: Get my recent daily stats
tools.description: Return the signed-in user's daily aggregates (total reps, sessions, total duration) for the last N days. Newest first.

days.description: Number of days back to fetch (1-90). Defaults to 14.
